verification_flow: Step 1 – Student shares soft copies on WhatsApp/e-mail/portal → Step 2 – MIODL counsellor pre-checks eligibility & documents → Step 3 – Documents uploaded on university application portal → Step 4 – University verifies (2–7 working days) → Step 5 – Provisional admission letter & fee payment → Step 6 – Enrollment no., LMS login, ABC/APAAR ID → Step 7 – Original verification only if the university asks. Admission proceeds ONLY after successful document verification.
process_note: All documents must be submitted as clear SOFT COPIES (scanned PDF/JPG, readable, max ~2 MB each). Documents are VERIFIED by the university / admission team first; admission is processed only after successful verification. Originals may be asked for physical verification later if the university requires.
abc_note: Mandatory for every online/ODL learner (UGC & NEP-2020). Created with Aadhaar-linked mobile number during admission; credits earned are deposited in the Academic Bank of Credits.
max_duration_rule: UG degree: min 3 yrs / max 6 yrs. PG degree: min 2 yrs / max 4 yrs. Diploma: 1 yr / max 2 yrs. Certificate: 6 months / max 1 yr. Learners can complete at their own pace within the max window.
reservation_note: Most universities give 5% relaxation in minimum marks to SC/ST/OBC/PwD/EWS candidates (e.g. 50% → 45%). Category certificate must be uploaded to claim it.
disclaimer: Eligibility, fees and intake dates are decided by the respective university and may change without notice. Admission is subject to document verification by the university. Please contact MIODL counsellors (98 33 07 44 76 / www.degreecomplete.in) for the latest confirmation before payment.
